<translate>
<!--T:1-->
DragonMineZ adds its own meats and fish, hunted from the wildlife of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. More importantly, '''eating any food''', vanilla, DMZ or from another mod, also restores a share of your '''health, ki and stamina'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Food restores health, ki and stamina == <!--T:2-->

<!--T:3-->
When you eat, the hunger and saturation the food restores also give back a slice of your resources. With the default settings, each hunger point restores:

<!--T:4-->
* '''1%''' of your max health;
* '''1%''' of your max ki;
* '''2%''' of your max stamina.

<!--T:5-->
Saturation adds a little more on top. Foods that restore fewer than 2 hunger points give no hunger-based recovery, and anything above 20 counts as 20. Server owners can exclude specific foods or whole mods.

<!--T:6-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Majin|Majins]] heal 25% more from food thanks to their '''Sweet Tooth''' passive.
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|food}}

<translate>
== DMZ foods == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Raw meat can be cooked in a furnace, a smoker or on a campfire. Animals that die while on fire drop it already cooked.
</translate>
